column1: # seconds2wall fixture data — Octave/MATLAB reference for parity testing
# Source: realized/seconds2wall.m — Seconds past midnight to wall clock conversion
# Converts seconds past midnight to wall-clock times in HHMMSS numeric format
#   - 0 <= seconds < 86400 (valid range: midnight to end of day)
#   - seconds is cast to double to protect against integer inputs
#   wall:  m-by-1 column vector of wall times (e.g. 93047
#   1. market_open:        seconds=34200  -> wall=93000 (US equity market open)
#   2. market_close:       seconds=57600  -> wall=160000 (US equity market close)
#   3. market_range:       14 second values every 1800s (30 min) from 9:30-16:00
#   7. late_evening:       seconds=86399 -> wall=235959 (near end of valid range)
